title: ANYbotics begins delivering ANYmal X legged robot for explosive atmospheres
summary: ANYbotics has designed the ANYmal X inspection robot to comply with the strictest safety standards of the oil, gas, and chemical industries. The post ANYbotics begins delivering ANYmal X legged robot for explosive atmospheres appeared first on The Robot Report.
investorNote: 工业机器人商业化要从演示跨到危险场景认证、稳定运行和维护系统集成。

fact.subject: ANYbotics
fact.object: 防爆环境巡检四足机器人 ANYmal X

evidence.quote: ANYbotics AG today launched ANYmal X, which it claimed is “the world’s first legged inspection robot for explosive atmospheres.”
ANYbotics built ANYmal X to comply with the ATEX standard in Europe and IECEx globally.
the field-tested, industrial-grade robot now being delivered to customers.

displayTitle: ANYbotics 开始交付防爆巡检四足机器人 ANYmal X
narrative: ANYbotics 推出并开始向客户交付 ANYmal X，面向油气和化工等有爆炸性气氛的设施巡检。The Robot Report 报道其按欧洲 ATEX 和全球 IECEx 要求设计，搭载热成像、声学、视觉与气体传感器。核心门槛不在四足形态本身，而在每个高功率部件的安全认证，以及能否把巡检读数接入维护流程。

eventRelation.reason: 当天推出并开始交付的新型号，区别于 ANYbotics 既有巡检机器人。
